Name: Expanded Events with Astarion
Author: saltwatered
Description:
This mod is an add-on for WhisperWillow's﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]Baldur's Valley[/url] mod. 

I've noticed that there's a lack of events after marriage, so I decided to take things into my own hands! This mod adds three new custom events, including yearly birthday celebrations, repeatable dates, and mini-events– all unlocked after you marry Astarion. Also included is more event-related dialogue.

[b]New events:[/b]
A list of all the events currently implemented. Watch out for spoilers!

[spoiler]
A stroll in the forest: It's the weekend! Astarion invites you for a walk by Marnie's ranch. 
Requirements: 20% chance on a sunny Saturday or Sunday

Reflection in the waves: You find Astarion standing on the beach, staring off into the horizon.
Requirements: 30% chance on a sunny Monday, between 11am and 4pm

Birthday bash: It's Fall 5, baby! Astarion's having drinks on a Friday night to celebrate his birthday (and you're invited). 
Requirements: Date is Fall 5
[/spoiler]

[b]Download instructions:
[/b]1. Download and extract the zip file
2. Put the 'Marital Bliss with Astarion' folder in Stardew Valley's 'Mods' file
3. Profit (???)

[b]Other notes:
[/b]In the screenshots, I'm using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52845636]GlitchedinOrbit[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21312]Replacement Portraits[/url] mod. Go check them out!
